title: When the Protocol Breaks
author: Silas Pemberton
blurb: Xanthe Lockridge, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
